Research Questions

Uncertainty is part of the public record. These questions define what the project still needs to establish.

Research statusOpen question

Questions on this page are research objectives, not biographical facts. They remain open until source-linked claims resolve them.

    Who were his parents?

  3. 03

Next work

Priority research queue

The order favors records most likely to resolve identity and chronology.

01

Search Baden-Baden address books

Check the 1928, 1930, 1932, 1935, and 1938 volumes for residence, occupation, household, and disappearance from the directory.

Research targets: SRC-023
02

Inspect the 1929 Hotel Messmer advertisement

Verify its date, wording, and Gottlieb's stated role from the original item.

Research targets: SRC-007
03

Identify the 1931 bankruptcy court file

Seek birth, nationality, residence, marital status, creditors, and business arrangements behind the notice.

Research targets: SRC-020
04

Search the Schweizer Hotel-Revue

Search 1908–1925 for appointments, departures, hotel changes, advertisements, and personal notices.

Research targets: SRC-024
05

Search Zürich registration and address records

Trace first appearance, residence, departure, and any person-level link to the full name.

Research targets: SRC-005, SRC-012
06

Inspect the 1938 Savoy centenary book

Search the volume for Gottlieb, predecessors, successors, and the unresolved management chronology.

Research targets: SRC-010
07

Reopen the 1932 and 1934 directory pages

Capture exact scans, bibliographic data, and commercial wording before interpreting Inhaber.

Research targets: SRC-008, SRC-009
08

Investigate the Lassmann connection

Test the possible Zürich–Baden property link without assuming it explains Gottlieb's move.

Research targets: SRC-018, SRC-021, SRC-022, SRC-026
09

Return to Vienna records with stronger identifiers

Use any precise age, date, nationality, or residence recovered in Baden or Zürich to locate the original birth record.

Research targets: SRC-011, SRC-025
10

Search Baden-Baden death records and press

Work forward after 1931 without assuming a death date or place.

Research targets: SRC-013, SRC-017
